question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

‘An official division within a religious group’
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Schism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Schism"** refers to an official division or separation within a religious group or organization due to differences in beliefs or practices. (धार्मिक गुट में फूट)
 
 
• **Example:** The schism between the two factions of the church led to the formation of a new denomination.
 
 
• The correct word **"Schism"** signifies a formal split, particularly in religious or ideological contexts, arising from disagreements. (धार्मिक या वैचारिक मतभेद के कारण औपचारिक विभाजन)
 
 
• **Example:** The Great Schism of 1054 resulted in the division of Christianity into the Eastern Orthodox Church and the Roman Catholic Church.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Schism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apostasy** (धर्मत्याग): The abandonment or renunciation of a religious or political belief.
 
 
• **Example:** His act of apostasy shocked his religious community.
 
 

 
• **Sedition** (विद्रोह): Conduct or speech inciting people to rebel against the authority of a state.
 
 
• **Example:** The leader was arrested for sedition after calling for a rebellion against the government.
 
 

 
• **Dissent** (असहमति): The expression or holding of opinions that differ from those previously, commonly, or officially held.
 
 
• **Example:** The student voiced her dissent against the new university policies.
